Omeprazole, oral, 0.7–1.4 mg/kg/day once daily. Specialist initiated. · Maximum dose: 20–40 mg/dose. If 1 month–2 years: 5 mg once daily.

adverse_effects.t: Headache, diarrhoea, hypomagnesaemia, C. difficile and fracture risk with long-term use
